Author: Anomaly
Name: Eorzea Timers
Punchline: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Description: Create persistent, personalized countdown timers with configurable icons, colors, formats, completion alerts, and an in-game overlay.
Changelog:
Stage 5 - Completion Alerts
- Added a custom completion popup with a Dismiss button.
- Added per-timer popup, sound, and chat-message options.
- Added a Test Completion Alert button.
- Added duplicate-alert protection and queued simultaneous completions.
- Existing completed timers do not alert unexpectedly after updating.
- Fixed the overlay moving while dragging its resize grip.
- Removed the temporary v0.4.2.0 4/20 image.
